app_defects_seen.background name: chisurf/macros/model.py set_background_curve stores DataCurve(x=, y=) without the name, so the Generic box's Background field reads 'DataCurve' after loading a background (visible in manual_generic.png).
app_defects_seen.lin table name: the Lin. table curve_input in the TCSPC view specs (e.g. chisurf/core/models/views/tcspc_lifetime.view.json) has no name_attr and set_linearization stores an unnamed copy, so a loaded linearisation table never shows in the field (manual_corrections.png shows the placeholder).
